predictions: Not quite as good as week 1, but my 19-8 record last week is still pretty stout. Lost a handful of them in the last game, as per usual. That total brings me to 39-15 (72.2% correct) for the season, which is more than a decent start. My debacle in F division continues though, as my one correct F pick in week 2 now brings me to a total of… 1 correct F pick so far. Maybe the more interesting part in my record is that my second- worst division rate so far is in my own division! Yep, I'm only 4-2 in A.

Match of the week: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Area 501. We are just one week 1 tiebreaker loss by the Secrets from this being a pair of 2-0s fighting for the top of C. This outcome could prove important for basically the duration of the season. Area is going the distance, 14-10.

Match #2: (D Div.) Point & Rally @ Nine Lives. There are a few teams that I expect to be defining the D race, and these are two of them. The Niners already lost a close one to another of the early contenders, and sadly, I think they are about to lose to a second one. Rally rallies, 15-9.

Match #3: (C Div.) Mulligans Mafia @ Menace 2 Sobriety. The only team outpacing Area in C so far is Menace. And while the Mafia is 1-1, they have already faced a pair of the other top C squads, so they are firmly in this title discussion too. Mafia upends the race a bit, 13-11.

Match #4: (H Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Bright Side of Flights. The Rangers sit as one of three undefeated squads at the top of H, and this week they are the only one of the three not facing a winless team. Bright Side is coming off a big win, so this is no gimme. Still the Rangers, 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Darty Sanchez @ One Armed Bandits. D is one of the more polar divisions so far. And Sanchez sits 0-2 while the One Armed Bandits sit 2-0, so this outcome should be obvious, right? Well, then why the heck am I taking Sanchez?! But I am… Sanchez, 14-10.

Match #6: (G Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Aim-ing for Trouble. These two have taken on the same two opponents so far, they got roughly the same result against each opponent, and now they both sit in the traffic jam in the middle of G. Time for the Machine to move, 14-10.
Match #7: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Cheap Shots. The top two 0.500 teams in F each can stick right behind the two leaders with a win. This one is going to be tight… That's What She Said, 13-11.
Match #8: (B Div.) Bottoms Up @ Consistently Inconsistent. The Bottoms have been climbing the ladder season after season. But this is where they start tasting a bit of that A/B opposition. CI, 15-9.
Match #9: (F Div.) Down to F, Again @ Nein Mark. Nein Mark has fought to two tough wins and sits atop F. Meanwhile, 0-1 Down to F is only "down" because they were in E last season. DTF in 1001.

Match #10: (E Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Outlaw Arrows. Stop me if you've heard this before… Dartness plays lots of close matches… and they are again. Sadly, this close one will be an Arrow win, 13-11.
Match #11: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Angry Birds. The Birds have already taken two tough losses. And now they face a team that often finds itself in A division. I'll be taking the Serious, 14-10.
Match #12: (A Div.) Jonesing for Mugs @ Darty Minds. Darty has taken a whoopin', and dished out a whoopin'. Meanwhile, the Joneses' only match was as close as is possible. Jonesing, 17-7.
